item.title: Choose a community garden job
item.summary: A volunteer finds a garden job that fits her time and experience.
item.transcript_text:
Leila: I'd like to volunteer on Saturday. I can stay from nine to eleven, but I've never used gardening tools.
Ben: We paint plant labels at nine. No experience is needed. The digging group starts at ten, but they work until twelve.
Leila: I'll paint the labels. Do I bring paint?
Ben: No, we have paint and brushes. Bring a hat and some water. It gets sunny near the greenhouse.
Leila: Great. I'll meet you by the gate.

questions.prompt: Why does Leila choose to paint labels?
options: It lets her leave by eleven and needs no experience
She can only arrive at ten
questions.explanation: Painting starts at nine and requires no experience. Digging goes past the time she can stay.
Ben says they already have paint and brushes.

questions.prompt: Where do they plan to meet?
questions.explanation: Leila says she will meet him by the gate.

children.segment_text: Bring a hat and some water.
